npcRoster.name: Daimon Mneme
npcRoster.publicDescription: Daimon Mneme is an agender Shifter memory architect who speaks like a gentle philosopher while hiding the sharpest tools behind mercy. At the Avarelyn Watch Office, they protect the Choral Synod through memory work, refuge design, secret histories, and selective omissions meant to prevent open war. Daimon truly wants peace, but they have crossed the line enough times to believe that editing the truth may be kinder than letting people destroy themselves with it.

Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi. Shifter reads through the Shifter entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Beast-touched humanoids capable of temporarily manifesting predatory traits such as claws, speed, or senses. They are driven by instinct but remain culturally grounded. Table cues: Bestial Instincts, Darkvision, Shifting; starting tendency Selfish - Lawful - Combative - Neutral.

npcRoster.name: Tristan Lucade
npcRoster.publicDescription:
Tristan Lucade is a quick-footed, restless Harengon merchant with bright nerves, sharper instincts, and a guilty need to fix damage he helped cause. As an Iskareth-shaped beastfolk, he is reactive, evasive, socially alert, and driven by kinship bonds, which makes him excellent at reading customers, danger, and family trouble before anyone says the quiet part aloud.
At the Avarélyn Watch Office, Tristan sells general goods, repair supplies, bunker stock, diluted legal ichor tonics, and discreet recovery materials through the Regent Lattice, though his past involvement in feeding his sibling’s ichor addiction still haunts him. He is bored by sheltered vault life, desperate for a larger world, and trying to become useful enough that his worst mistake is not the only thing people remember.

npcRoster.publicDescription: Hyris Rooftreader is a lean, watchful Tabaxi courier who treats rooftops, chimneys, laundry lines, and bell towers as safer roads than anything with a gate. They move messages, ration tokens, and emergency warnings between Freeblade safehouses, preferring speed and surprise over heroic speeches. Hyris is cocky on the roofline and tender in private, especially with fugitives who freeze when freedom requires one more dangerous jump.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.

globalNamedWeatherDefinitions.What it means: When both moons favor the sea at once, harbor stones vanish and reef roads drown.
A low, quiet tide that exposes mud gates, wreck bones, and hidden causeways.
A low-pressure sea storm arriving with a strong moon tide.
A sudden retreat of water before trench-fed surge returns.
A black-green wall of rain that crosses whole coasts.
Short, sharp squalls that arrive in pairs or trios every few days.
Moonlit fog so bright it makes ships look closer than they are.
A towering thunderhead that forms over heated highlands.
Greenish swamp fog carrying spores, firefly light, and bad directions.
A suffocating, windless heat that freezes sails and tempers alike.
A rotating storm whose calm center is ringed by clear, staring sky.
Low rolling thunder that repeats long before the rain reaches a settlement.
Warm gas-fog from marsh canals and low cave mouths.
A fine crosswind rain that seems to fall sideways from many directions.
Shimmering heat that turns distance into false water and false stone.
Three winds meeting over cliffs, reefs, or a canyon mouth.
A steep, dark swell pushed by far-off pressure changes.
Warm rain that wakes rot, swollen roots, and hungry fungus.
A sudden evening wind that turns forest travel loud and blind.
A hooked dust plume ahead of dryline storms.
Highland lightning that walks along exposed ridges.
Rain-soaked clay roads that swallow carts and boots.
A season when road puddles hide sinkholes, leeches, and false bottoms.
A dry graveyard wind that carries dust, spores, and old sickness.
A clean mountain lift used by skyships and great birds.
A fast pull beneath reef water during strong tide shifts.
Thin cold rain that whistles through ruins and empty rigging.
One storm-fed river splits into several dangerous surges.
A spiraling river or sea current that turns boats sideways.
A soft glowing insect and spore bloom after warm moon rain.

majorWaters.Name: Moonwake Ocean
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The broad central water where both moons pull the most famous tide roads.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Silver tide lanes, copper moonlet rips, fog over reef shelves.

majorWaters.Name: Seleneš Western Deep
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The western open blue beyond the largest green lands.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Long swells, omenbergs, cold upwelling lanes.

majorWaters.Name: Nannara Eastern Blue
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The eastern deep ocean beyond the horned lands and high islands.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Copper-moon currents, typhoon-birth warmth, floating kelp forests.

majorWaters.Name: Horundar Storm Ocean
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The southern storm-breeding water where warm seas feed the hardest rain.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Cyclone chains, storm-stack tides, blackwater squalls.

majorWaters.Name: Bastveig Trenchsea
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The abyssal water over the deepest ice-crowns and trench cities.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Pressure ice, hydrate vents, dead-water bubbles, blind leviathans.

majorWaters.Name: Sokhivar Sunsea
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The bright shallow equatorial sea between reef-rich coasts.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Reef glare, spawning tides, salt haze, glass-calm heat.

majorWaters.Name: Ishtanora Hearthsea
majorWaters.Where it belongs: The sheltered inland sea of trade winds, hearth ports, and drum-tide festivals.
majorWaters.Weather and life: Warm rains, gentle neaps, sudden squall gates.
